    {
      "from": "Authorized",
      "event": "PUBLISH packet",
      "action": "publish the message to all valid subscribers of the topic",
      "to": "Authorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorized",
      "event": "PUBLISH packet",
      "action": "return 0x80 (Unspecified error) if they do not want to leak the Topic Names to unauthorized clients",
      "to": "Authorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorized",
      "event": "SUBSCRIBE packet",
      "action": "issue SUBACK packet with return code 0x87 (Not authorized) for unauthorized Topic Filters",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorized",
      "event": "SUBSCRIBE packet",
      "action": "issue SUBACK packet with return code 0x80 (Unspecified error) for unauthorized Topic Filters",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorized",
      "event": "SUBSCRIBE packet",
      "action": "issue SUBACK packet with success codes for authorized Topic Filters",
      "to": "Authorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unauthorized",
      "event": "PUBLISH packet",
      "action": "close Network Connection and send DISCONNECT packet with reason code 0x87 (Not authorized)",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    }
